title: Grade Calculator
description:
Given `score = 78`, print the letter grade:
- A: 90 and above
- B: 80 and above
- C: 70 and above
- D: 60 and above
- F: below 60

**Expected output:**
```
C
```
hint: Use if/elif/else. Check from highest to lowest: if score >= 90, elif score >= 80, elif score >= 70, etc.
